levels.surface: أبي عمران موسى بن زنجويه الأرمني

notes: «الجريري و اسمه سفيان» is a gloss on the nisba and is left out
«و رويته عن أبي» gives the father with no source written after him; the semicolon starts the second chain, so the father's route stops at that word as written
«عن عبد الله بن الحكم» stands twice: the first and second occurrences are the ends of two different chains; «أبي» is the second bare occurrence of that word
